tours.name: Special Characters in an Employee Name

name_i18n.en_US: Special Characters in an Employee Name

tours.description: Learn how Odoo handles an apostrophe, a hyphen, an ampersand and angle brackets typed in a name, without saving anything.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how Odoo handles an apostrophe, a hyphen, an ampersand and angle brackets typed in a name, without saving anything.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Employees are created in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Employees are created in the Employees app.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start an employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start an employee.

steps.description: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

steps.title: Type the name
steps.content: Type O'Connor-Silva & Sons <ZZ>, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type O'Connor-Silva & Sons <ZZ>, then press Tab.

steps.description: Names in real life contain apostrophes, hyphens, ampersands and even brackets. Odoo accepts them and shows them as typed, without treating the brackets as code.

description_i18n.en_US: Names in real life contain apostrophes, hyphens, ampersands and even brackets. Odoo accepts them and shows them as typed, without treating the brackets as code.

steps.title: Check the name
steps.content: Look at the name. Click the field to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the name. Click the field to continue.

steps.description: The name is kept exactly as typed. Remember the special characters when you search for this person later: type them the same way.

description_i18n.en_US: The name is kept exactly as typed. Remember the special characters when you search for this person later: type them the same way.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.
